$description: Structurally unusual facts, documented explicitly instead of normalised away.

items.summary: No link may point to an external domain; only internal routes, mailto: and tel:. Docs -> /developers/, Careers -> /careers/, partner logos non-clickable, LinkedIn removed, blog share buttons non-navigating (Copy Link works). Forms fake submission locally with no network requests.

evidence.anchor: Facebook do NOT open external share URLs
the LinkedIn link was removed by request

items.summary: /developers/ and /careers/ do not exist on the original; they replace the external Docs/Careers links. Template info-page is origin 'clone-only'.

evidence.anchor: internal replacement for the external "Docs" link
internal replacement for the external careers subdomain

items.summary: Blog has 6 placeholder posts (original: 148 incl. 1 schema post) and 7 categories (original 10). Deliberate; do not recreate the full set.

Impilo is a real company. Gilroy is a commercial font licensed to Impilo; homepage copy, illustrations, logos (incl. partner logos and HIPAA/SOC2/ISO/HQAA/FDA badges), staff photos (real people) and blog covers (stock/news imagery) are third-party. Non-homepage body copy is original placeholder text. See assets/asset-roles.json.

evidence.anchor: Copy is original placeholder text written to

items.summary: Dark-section titles on /solutions/digital-health-logistics/ and /solutions/clinic-rpm/ render white; the original renders blue01-on-blue01 (invisible).

shared/LaptopShowcase.jsx (/integrations/) and solutions/SolutionsLaptop.jsx (/solutions/) are deliberately separate: title wrapping, heading level, screen-size animation, controlled vs uncontrolled state, mobile layout and animation hooks differ.

evidence.anchor: export default function SolutionsLaptop({ slides, active, onPrev, onNext })

items.summary: The original uses ScrollSmoother; the clone uses native scroll with equivalent soft-pin drift (utils.softPin) and CSS sticky for the blog pins.
The reCAPTCHA / Google policy note (external links) is omitted on /request-demo/.

evidence.anchor: The reCAPTCHA / Google policy note is intentionally omitted

items.summary: COMPANY_PAGES_SPEC A.4 says to use placeholders, but the clone's Leadership renders real names with real headshots (and the about marquee real team photos). The design-repo forbids reproducing them in generated output (photo.person = placeholder-only; names must be placeholders).

evidence.anchor: - **Team grid: 3 people.** Use placeholders, not the real names or photos.

items.summary: BLOG_SPEC still says generated placeholder covers live in public/assets/blog/ (cover-1..6.svg, inline-1.svg). That directory no longer exists in the source (removed during this build); all 6 posts and the inline image now use cover-*.webp copied from the original site (third-party stock/news imagery -> photo.editorial-cover, placeholder-only for generated pages).

evidence.anchor: Placeholder imagery (generated, on-brand, no original photos)

items.summary: One placeholder post title is 21 words (deliberate 3-line clamp test) — above the original's measured 3–17 words. blog.post maxWords stays 17 (original evidence).

evidence.anchor: 5. Long 3-line title, to show the clamp.
